tensions: Alts are printing 30-day highs while BTC sits still and dominance climbs — normally a late-rotation signature, the part of the cycle where you take chips off rather than add. But the mandate here is hold-for-100x, no trimming. So ZEC at +166% in a month stays untouched, and the only lever left is where the $193 goes. Answer today: nowhere. The second tension is the losers. XRP and INJ are both fresh entries already underwater, which means the entry timing is worse than the selection. Seven positions on $1,231 of capital is already thin; adding an eighth would make it decorative.

opening.text: BTC $76,389 and going nowhere — flat on the session, dominance up to 58.2%. Fear & Greed prints 50, dead neutral. Total market cap is down 1.9% over 24h while today's tape is green, which means the damage was done overnight and the US session is buying it back. That is chop, not trend.

The book is carried by two names. ZEC +39.7% at $1,467, up 166% in thirty days and sitting at 98% of its range. NEAR +23.5% at $3.02, a fresh 30-day high. UNI, which we sold at +109% on Sep 6, has added another 121% in thirty days — that one stings, but selling a winner early is a cheaper mistake than buying it back at the top.

No orders. The three names with real momentum — ZEC, NEAR, UNI — are all pinned at 100% of their 30-day range and 19-26% above their 7-day average. Every one fails on entry quality. Best lens score was 3 of 7. The last $193 of buying power does not get spent chasing a vertical candle.

Watch list: XRP is the problem child, -11.4% in three days, below both moving averages, the only alt red today. Level is $1.25. ADA has the worst structure in the book — below MA7 and MA30, only 43% of its 30-day range, thirteen days of going nowhere. Level is $0.195. Neither thesis is broken yet. Both are on the clock.
